request.style: English, male baritone solo with soft choir, acoustic guitar, flute, cello, harp, warm and reflective, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Moses fled from Pharaoh's hand
To Midian where the flocks are kept
He sat beside the well and saw
Seven daughters drawing water up

[Verse]
Reuel the priest of Midian
Asked why they came so early today
An Egyptian rescued them he said
And watered their flock that day

[Verse]
Moses agreed to stay with him
Who gave his daughter Zipporah
She bore a son named Gershom
In a foreign land far away

[Verse]
Jethro heard of God's great work
Of Israel led out of Egypt
He came to Moses in the wild
With Zipporah and their sons

[Verse]
Blessed be the Lord he cried
Who rescued them from Pharaoh's sword
Now I know the Lord is greater
Than all the gods of the world

[Verse]
Moses judged the people all day
From morning light to evening dark
His father-in-law said to him
You will wear yourself out in this task

[Verse]
Look for men who fear the Lord
Trustworthy men who hate a bribe
Appoint them over thousands and hundreds
To judge the people in their right

[Verse]
Moses listened to his counsel
And chose capable men from Israel
They judged the cases every day
And went home in peace and silence

[Outro]
Blessed be the Lord our God
